title: WASM extension sandboxing: fuel limits, memory caps, syscall restrictions
description: Tier 2 WASM extensions are third-party code. Must enforce: fuel/instruction limits (no infinite loops), memory caps (no unbounded allocation), no filesystem/network/syscall access, no access to other games' state. A malicious or buggy extension must not escape the sandbox, exhaust host memory, or run forever. Applies to both client-side and server-side WASM execution.
